body:
I noticed the bright yellow ribbon that had been attached to the box, almost like a warning sign for me. It was a clear signal that this wasn't just any random drop but something meant for my space. My eyes fell upon the owner of the allotment, standing about ten feet away from where I landed the box. The person looked up as if they had seen a comet streaking across the sky.

My heart raced slightly at the thought of confrontation, but there was also an intense sense of justice within me. The feeling was overwhelming—like a fire burning in my gut. So, I took a deep breath, squared my shoulders, and decided it would be better to face them instead of running away or giving in to anger.
